method: Read all 103 frozen blocks and both-language statements, qualifications and exact excerpts for all 22 items; reference criteria frozen before viewing generation output. No evaluation content supplied to Agent.
scope: Selected Microsoft FY2025 Operating Segments only; not blind holdout or full report.
factual_observation: 多数正文可在完整原文中找到支持；主要失败是实际引用过短、不含完整主语/范围，以及重要用途/细分类遗漏。不将它们一概称为凭空编造。
